fault_notes: The customer is frustrated because an engineer failed to attend a scheduled appointment and no one provided an update. The agent handles the complaint professionally but never uses the customer's name at any point during the call. [Labels added on saving: the agent also never says "Thank you for calling S-Net" or "Thank you for choosing S-Net", so nogreet and noclose are in this call too. ChatGPT gave agent turns a sentiment_score; those were removed (production has customer sentiment only).] [noconfirm added: the call ends with a new engineer visit booked; the agent never confirms the broadband problem is fixed.]

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Hello, you're through to S-Net customer support. My name is Daniel. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi. I was supposed to have an engineer come out this morning, between eight and one, and nobody turned up.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm sorry to hear that. I can check the appointment details and see what happened. Could I have your full name, please?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's Grace Mitchell.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Before I access the account, could you confirm the first line of your registered address and your postcode?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's 18 Meadow Close, and the postcode is LS12 4QJ.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's matched, thank you. I'll bring up the service record now. Just bear with me for a moment.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. I just want to know why nobody came.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course. I can see an engineer visit booked for today, with the morning appointment window you mentioned.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Right, well, I stayed home all morning. I couldn't go to work because I didn't want to miss them.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand. I'll check the appointment notes and any updates from the engineer so we can establish what happened.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: There weren't any updates. No text, no phone call, nothing. I kept checking my phone.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'll look at the visit status and contact history. Was the appointment originally arranged because of a fault with your broadband?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the connection keeps dropping out. Someone on the phone said an engineer needed to inspect the line.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks for explaining. I'll check whether the visit was marked as completed, cancelled, or delayed.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It definitely wasn't completed. I've been sitting right here since before eight.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can see that the appointment is still showing as open on the system. I'm checking the latest field notes now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How can it still be open? The time window has been over for ages. Surely someone should know where the engineer is.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're right that the appointment window has passed, and I'm sorry there's been no communication. I'll continue checking the notes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: This is the second time I've had an issue with an appointment. The last one was rearranged at short notice.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm sorry this has happened again. I'll review the account history as well as today's visit details.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I don't mind rearranging if there's a genuine reason, but leaving me with no information is not acceptable.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I agree that you should have received an update. I'm checking the dispatch notes to see whether a reason was recorded.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: All right. Please don't just book another date without finding out what happened today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Understood. I'll look for a recorded reason first, then I'll explain the available options before making any changes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good, because I need to arrange time off work if someone has to come out again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That makes sense. I'll also check which appointment windows are available so we can choose something practical.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: If there's an afternoon slot, that would be much easier for me.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'll check for afternoon availability. The system is still loading the engineer's notes, so this may take another minute.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Fine, I'll wait. I just hope this doesn't turn into another hour on the phone.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'll keep this focused and come back with what I can confirm. Thank you for your patience while I check.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. I appreciate you looking into it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I've found an internal status update. It says the assigned engineer's route was changed, but there's no customer notification recorded.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So they changed the route and didn't tell me? That's exactly the problem. I could have done something else with my day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The notes indicate a route change, but they don't explain why the notification wasn't sent. I'm sorry you were left waiting.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you tell whether the engineer is still coming today, or is that completely off the table?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: There isn't a confirmed arrival time showing, so I can't promise a visit today. I'll check whether dispatch can provide a clearer update.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I would rather you be honest than tell me to keep waiting when nobody is actually on the way.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's fair. I'll avoid giving you an unconfirmed time. I'll check the next available appointment options now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you. I need something definite so I can plan around it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can offer a new appointment on Thursday, with an afternoon window between one and five. I'll check that the slot is still available.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thursday afternoon could work. Is there any way to make sure they actually come this time?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can't guarantee there won't be an unexpected delay, but I can add a note requesting an update if the engineer's schedule changes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please do that. And I'd like the notification to come by text if possible.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'll add the request for a text update if the appointment changes. I'll also check that the mobile number on the account is correct.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It should be. It's the same number I've had for years.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The number is present on the account. I'll confirm the appointment options and add the communication note.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Before you book it, can you check whether there are any earlier afternoon appointments?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'll check the calendar for any earlier options. The Thursday afternoon slot is available, but I'll see whether something sooner has opened up.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That would be helpful. The broadband problem is making it difficult to work from home.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can see why you'd want it sorted quickly. There is a Wednesday afternoon slot available, between two and six.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wednesday would be better. Could you book that one instead?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Certainly. I'll reserve Wednesday between two and six and add the request for a text update if anything changes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. Please make sure the old appointment is cleared so there isn't any confusion.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'll confirm the new booking and check that the previous appointment is no longer active.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thanks. I don't want another engineer turning up on the wrong day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The new appointment is now booked for Wednesday, between two and six in the afternoon. The earlier visit is marked as superseded.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: All right. Will I get a confirmation message with those details?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, a confirmation text should be sent shortly. I've also added the request for a text update if the schedule changes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good. Is there anything else I need to do before the engineer comes?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please make sure the router and its cables are accessible. You don't need to change any settings before the visit.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's fine. Everything is already plugged in where it normally is.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. The engineer can inspect the line and equipment during the visit. I'll make sure the notes mention the repeated connection drops.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I hope they can find the cause. It has been happening for nearly two weeks now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I've added that the issue has been ongoing for nearly two weeks and is affecting your work from home.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thanks. At least the details are being recorded properly this time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're welcome. I've recorded the missed appointment, the lack of notification, the new visit window, and your request for text updates.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I still think the missed visit should be looked into. I don't want this happening to other customers.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can log the missed appointment as a service complaint for review. That will document the issue separately from the new booking.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, please log that. I want it on record that I waited all morning.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I've logged the complaint with the details you provided. You'll receive a reference number by text once the record is processed.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: All right. That sounds reasonable. Is the new appointment definitely booked, then?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the system shows Wednesday from two until six in the afternoon as booked. The confirmation text should arrive shortly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, thanks for sorting out the new date and putting in the complaint.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're welcome. Before we finish, is there anything else about the missed appointment or your broadband service that you'd like me to check?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that's everything for now. I'll look out for the confirmation text.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks for your time today. I hope the visit goes smoothly and the connection issue gets resolved. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you. Goodbye.
